verdict.rationale: Brex documents autonomous background agents (audit agent monitoring expenses, review agent auto-approving low-risk items and escalating exceptions) plus webhook events and third-party automation platforms (Zapier, Workato, Pipedream) that can run unattended once configured, and an MCP server for AI assistant integration. This covers the core 'runs autonomously in background' story via policy-driven agents and event-driven webhooks/automations. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these agents truly run unattended without human triggers, and technical detail on scheduling/trigger architecture beyond marketing copy
